native_account_topology.description: Choose one native account topology with complete canonical merchant ownership and vault consequences.

pilot_terminal_adapter.description: Choose the exact first terminal/app/acquirer combination; the other adapter remains expansion work.

authorization_owner.description: Declare whether the gateway dispatches authorization or an approved vendor application already executes it. Vendor selection activates CTX-141 before the relevant integration/security/certification gates.

application_layer_jwe.description: Record whether the approved first integration requires supplementary JWE. True activates CTX-088 in downstream security/certification/release checks; false preserves approved opaque vendor transport.
